sql:

FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i ON i.invoiceid = il.invoiceid
WHERE i.invoicedate >= DATE '2013-01-01'
  AND i.invoicedate < DATE '2013-04-01'
LIMIT 501

sql:
SELECT c.customerid, c.customername
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol
JOIN wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitems si ON si.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT orderid, customerid FROM wideworldimporters.sales.invoices) inv ON inv.orderid = ol.orderid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = inv.customerid
WHERE LOWER(si.brand) = 'northwind'
GROUP BY c.customerid, c.customername
ORDER BY SUM(ol.quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1

WHERE LOWER(si.brand) = 'northwind'
GROUP BY c.customerid, c.customername
ORDER BY SUM(ol.quantity) DESC

sql:
SELECT cc.customercategoryname AS customer_category,
       AVG(ot.order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM (
    SELECT o.orderid, o.customerid, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
    FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
    JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
    GROUP BY o.orderid, o.customerid
) ot
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = ot.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customercategories cc ON cc.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid
GROUP BY cc.customercategoryid, cc.customercategoryname
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC
LIMIT 500
proposed:
SELECT cc.customercategoryname AS customer_category,
       AVG(ot.order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM (
    SELECT o.orderid, o.customerid, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
    FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
    JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
    GROUP BY o.orderid, o.customerid
) ot
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = ot.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customercategories cc ON cc.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid
GROUP BY cc.customercategoryid, cc.customercategoryname
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC
LIMIT 500

sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wideworldimporters.sales.customers.customerid) AS customer_count
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.customers
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customertransactions
  ON wideworldimporters.sales.customertransactions.customerid = wideworldimporters.sales.customers.customerid
WHERE wideworldimporters.sales.customers.standarddiscountpercentage > 0
  AND wideworldimporters.sales.customertransactions.invoiceid IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM wideworldimporters.sales.customertransactions.transactiondate) = 2024
LIMIT 501

sql:
SELECT s.supplierid, s.suppliername, SUM(il.quantity) AS items_sold
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT supplierid, stockitemid
  FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemtransactions
  WHERE supplierid IS NOT NULL
) sp
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il ON il.stockitemid = sp.stockitemid
JOIN wideworldimporters.purchasing.suppliers s ON s.supplierid = sp.supplierid
GROUP BY s.supplierid, s.suppliername
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 5
proposed:

) sp
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il ON il.stockitemid = sp.stockitemid
JOIN wideworldimporters.purchasing.suppliers s ON s.supplierid = sp.supplierid
GROUP BY s.supplierid, s.suppliername
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 5
